verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a self-hostable feature-flag server, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out setting. Related privacy points, such as Edge keeping targeting PII local, self-hosting, and external metrics staying in your own system, are adjacent features, not an opt-out control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
